remarks: DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITY IN INGLEWOOD! Located on a quiet, tree-lined street in the mature and well-established community of Inglewood, this approximately 598 m² parcel offers approximately 14.06 m of frontage and 42.67 m of depth. The property is being offered for land value only and presents an excellent opportunity for builders and developers to explore redevelopment possibilities, or for those seeking a restoration project in a desirable central Edmonton location. RF3 zoning adds to the appeal of this well-proportioned site. Enjoy the character of an established neighbourhood with mature trees and convenient access to 124 Street, local shops, restaurants, services, transit and downtown Edmonton. A fantastic opportunity to secure a site in a sought-after inner-city community and bring your vision to life. (id:67522)
